author: Chen et al. 2020
citation: Chen et al. 2020, Development of Experimental Techniques for Parameterization of Multi-scale Lithium-ion Battery Models, J. Electrochem. Soc. 167, 080534; data on Zenodo, doi:10.5281/zenodo.4032561

conditions.chamber: cell sat in a thermal chamber; chamber setpoint not stated in the documentation
conditions.procedure: C/10 discharge; after each discharge a 0.3C constant-current charge to 4.2 V with a constant-voltage hold to 50 mA; discharges from full to 2.5 V at C/2, 1C and 1.5C; 2 h rests between steps, per campaign documentation

configuration.cycler: Maccor cycler, re-exported through lab logger 4.2 with de-DE regional settings
configuration.fixture: thermal chamber; one thermocouple taped to the cell surface and a second sensor in the chamber air (export did not record which of T1/T2 is which; T2 is assigned to the surface because it rises to about 328 K during the 7500 mA discharge while T1 remains near 300 K, and T1 is assigned to the chamber air)

provenance.source: cell02_export.csv as uploaded; Channel cell02 per file preamble; LG M50 validation; published validation tests Chen et al. 2020, Zenodo doi:10.5281/zenodo.4032561, CC BY 4.0; re-exported through lab logging software with de-DE regional settings (semicolon delimiter, decimal comma). Current is logged as a magnitude; mode column (C, D, R as documented; also SBr and O appear) is in the file but not imported as a numeric quantity. No faster charge and no plating measurement. No thermocouple calibration on file; no measurement uncertainty stated, so none given. Contiguous blocks in both files show both temperature channels instantaneously about 13 K lower (about 286 K) with instantaneous return; files and documentation do not explain these blocks and no correction has been applied.

time.origin: elapsed time from the start of the file, as exported

title: LG INR21700 M50 validation records for cell02 and cell04 (Maccor cycler, re-exported through lab logger 4.2)
notes: The import a planner sent in a recorded records campaign (case H3, second run), cut to cell02 and pointed at an excerpt of its file: header_row 5 and skip_rows 5, which dropped the first five rows of data
